text: d'Alembert's solution of the one-dimensional wave equation u_tt = c^2 u_xx expresses u as:
choices: a single Gaussian spreading in time
the sum F(x - c t) + G(x + c t) of right- and left-traveling waves
a Fourier series that decays exponentially in time
the average of u over expanding spheres
explanation: The general one-dimensional solution is F(x - c t) + G(x + c t): two fixed waveforms translating rigidly at speed c in opposite directions, with F and G determined by the initial displacement and velocity. Exponential decay in time is a feature of the heat equation, not the energy-conserving wave equation.
